channel.title: The Modern Schoolhouse
channel.description: A K-12 education blog on school choice, teaching trends, and student success

item.title: Why Safety & Belonging Now Drive School Choice
item.description: New 2026 data shows safety and belonging have overtaken academics as the top school-choice driver. Here's what families are really looking for—and why it matters.

item.title: Public Montessori Schools: What Families Need to Know
item.description: More families are choosing public Montessori programs in 2026. Here's what makes them different, what to expect, and how to decide if it's the right fit.

item.title: Beyond the Classroom: How Flex Charters Build Real Community
item.description: Flex charter schools offer more community enrichment than families expect. Here's how independent-study models close the "socialization gap" — and then some.

item.title: STEM Charter Schools: What Urban Families Should Know
item.description: STEM-focused charter schools are delivering real results for urban students in 2026. Here's what parents need to know before applying.

item.title: STEM, Character, and College Readiness: Why Schools Need All Three
item.description: Top K-12 schools in 2026 weave STEM, character education, and college readiness together. Here's why the trifecta matters—and what to look for in a school.

item.title: Place-Based Learning: Why Where You Teach Matters
item.description: Place-based learning connects K-12 students to their local community and environment—boosting engagement, achievement, and civic pride. Here's what the research shows.

item.title: Why Real-World Learning Is Winning the School Choice Debate
item.description: High school disengagement is pushing families toward schools built around real-world, project-based learning. Here's what 2026 research says for charter schools.

item.title: Why Families Choose Charter Schools in 2026
item.description: School choice is exploding in 2026. Here's what research reveals about why families still pick charter schools—and what separates the ones they trust most.

item.title: AI in the Classroom: Why Charter Schools Lead
item.description: Charter schools are moving faster on AI-powered personalized learning than most districts. Here's what the evidence actually shows — and what families should ask.

item.title: Charter Schools in a Crowded Market: How to Win in 2026
item.description: ESA expansion and declining birthrates have made K-12 enrollment a genuine competition. Here's how charter schools hold their edge in 2026-27.

item.title: Charter Schools & CTE: Building Real Career Pathways
item.description: Charter schools are uniquely built for CTE. Here's how their autonomy advantage is producing stronger workforce pathways for K-12 students in 2026.

item.title: Charter Schools & the Student Mental Health Crisis
item.description: Charter schools are uniquely positioned to address the K-12 student mental health crisis. Here's what the data shows and what leading schools are doing.

item.title: How a School's Curriculum Model Should Shape Your Choice
item.description: Not all K-12 curricula are equal. Learn how to evaluate a school's curriculum model—classical, knowledge-rich, or inquiry-based—before you enroll your child.

item.title: How Earning More Credits Per Year Changes Students
item.description: Discover how charter high schools that let students earn up to 8 credits per year—instead of the standard 4–6—boost motivation, graduation rates, and college readiness.

item.title: Why Millions of Parents Search for Schools But Never Switch
item.description: In 2026, nearly 20 million parents searched for a new school but didn't enroll. Here's what stops families — and how online charter schools remove every barrier.

item.title: Why Content Knowledge Is the New AI Literacy
item.description: AI tools flood K-12 classrooms in 2026, but real AI literacy starts with knowing things. Here's why content-rich schools have a quiet advantage.

item.title: What Tech Should Your Online Charter School Provide?
item.description: From Chromebooks to Canvas, here's the technology an online charter school should give K–12 students—and the questions every family should ask before enrolling.

item.title: The All-in-One Charter Network Families Want
item.description: More charter networks now span PreK–12 with multiple campuses and a statewide online option. Here's why the "all-under-one-charter" model is winning over families in 2026.

item.title: How Charter Schools Are Winning the Recovery Race
item.description: New 2026 research shows charter schools outpacing traditional public schools in academic recovery—especially for Black, Hispanic, and low-income students. Here's what's driving it.

item.title: Chronic Absenteeism in 2026: Why School Design Matters
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still affects nearly 1 in 4 K-12 students. Here's what 2025 research says about why—and which school designs actually fix it.
